doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth in Philadelphia and his parents
summary: Segal gives his name and birth date, jokes about his mohel, and says his mother Henrietta raised him after his father Irwin left.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Joe Segal: My name is Joseph Philip Segal. S-E-G-A-L. Not Seagal. Segal. I detest Seagal. And April 24, 1926, in Philadelphia. I don’t recall the hospital. But I’m told I had a female mohel, if you know what that is.
A mohel is the one that circumcises the young babies.

And I don’t remember that wonderful experience, cause I was an infant. I was raised mostly by my mother, cause my father sort of disappeared when I was about a year old. He didn’t disappear; he was put away from our household by my mother, cause she found him canoodling with someone else.
Can we get your mother’s name, full name?
